title: The use of in silico molecular modelling to screen potential estrogen mimics as part of medicines and agrochemicals development and product license applications.
authors: Bennie, Rachel Z; Shaw, Ian C
journal: Toxicology in vitro : an international journal published in association with BIBRA
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接模拟筛选雌激素类似物与雌激素受体的相互作用，对象为小分子-蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法上可部分借鉴，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: Estrogen mimics are a diverse group of synthetic and naturally occurring compounds that can interact with estrogen receptors (ERs) in animals, including humans. These interactions rely on key structural features of 17b-estradiol (E2) and if these molecular features are in a similar spatial arrangement on other compounds, they are likely to elicit an agonist (i.e., they are E2 mimics) or antagonist response. The structural diversity of some compounds vis-a-vis analogies with E2 makes it difficult to reliably predict E2 mimicry on simple structural grounds alone. We propose a new approach methodology: in silico molecular modelling augmented by an in vitro transactivation reporter gene assay to predict E2 mimicry and thus further reduce regulatory reliance on animal studies. Transactivation reporter gene assay dose response curves and in silico molecular modelling were used to obtain EC50-values and docking parameters (DockScores), respectively of thirty E2 mimics to assess the reliability of in silico receptor interaction parameters to predict E2 mimicry. A linear relationship (R2 = 0.75) was found between DockScores and EC50s, suggesting molecular modelling is a good tool for predicting E2 mimicry in a regulatory setting.
abstract_zh: 雌激素模拟物是一类多样化的合成及天然化合物，能够与包括人类在内的动物体内的雌激素受体（ERs）相互作用。这些相互作用依赖于17β-雌二醇（E2）的关键结构特征，如果这些分子特征在其他化合物上以相似的空间排列存在，则它们很可能引发激动剂（即它们是E2模拟物）或拮抗剂反应。某些化合物相对于E2的结构多样性使得仅凭简单的结构依据难以可靠预测E2模拟性。我们提出一种新方法学：通过计算机模拟分子建模（in silico molecular modelling）辅以体外反式激活报告基因实验（in vitro transactivation reporter gene assay）来预测E2模拟性，从而进一步减少监管中对动物研究的依赖。使用反式激活报告基因实验的剂量反应曲线和计算机模拟分子建模，分别获得了三十种E2模拟物的EC50值和对接参数（DockScores），以评估计算机模拟受体相互作用参数预测E2模拟性的可靠性。在DockScores与EC50s之间发现了线性关系（R² = 0.75），表明分子建模是监管环境中预测E2模拟性的良好工具。
